lines.1: 「...I came straight home without stopping anywhere.」
lines.2: Something about that Otome Kurogane made me uneasy.
lines.3: It was like I couldn't stand up to her, or... something.
lines.4: I should probably stop being late so she wouldn't put me on her list.
lines.6: Crab had remedial lessons, and Subaru was at track practice.
lines.7: Fukahire... Well, he was probably playing video games.
lines.9: A Kiriya Company commercial was playing.
lines.10: The Princess's parents owned it. Their company was seriously famous...
lines.11: It had grown so rapidly that people called it 'the upstart Kiriya.'
lines.14: No, this was the perfect time to lose myself in a hobby.
lines.15: I could work on a bottle ship.
lines.17: 「The texture of this mast... It's irresistible... This one's going to be a masterpiece.」
lines.18: 「God... Pant... pant... Bottle ships drive me wild...」
